desc: Indian snacks & freshly prepared cakes are the order of the day at this casual bakery chain link.
addr: 16, 11th Main Rd, 4th T Block East, 4th Block, Jayanagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560011, India

rev.t: What I love about cakewala is affordability, amazing taste and selection of items …

Stale cake was served and thankfully got an exchange on request!!
Stale Choco Lava! It was completely dry, and the server seemed to know it—yet still tried to pass it off instead of serving a fresh one.
Wouldn't recommend it for small kids—it can be quite risky.
This place is very close to Jayanagar 4th Block Signal and in front of Cool Joint and next to Reliance Jewellery. …
